dialogues.speaker: Aunt Qiao
dialogues.text: Even Stone Gate is bustling now... Haha, now that's a sight!

dialogues.speaker: Aunt Qiao
dialogues.text: You look weary, child. Why not take a rest?

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: Haha, young folks these days... Always brimming with new ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: A poetry gala... Ah, thinking back on my youth, I certainly had stories I could put to paper back then...

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...The world is eternal, but youth is ephemeral...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Now then, didn't you say you wanted to publish a book?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Yes, I do.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: ...So where's the book?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: It's in the works! Just waiting on the poems!

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: ...And where are the poems?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: They're on the way.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: ...Look, I'm sorry Director Hu, but how do you expect me to talk business with you when you don't even have the poems yet?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: I just figured while we're waiting, we could discuss terms in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Well, I need to see the content to decide if I even want to sell it, let alone how much to sell it for.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, I showed you a sample already, and it was some of my finest work! Besides, you only need a few highlights to sell an anthology!

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: ...You think your poem, "Fifteen Tenderloin Steaks" will carry the whole book, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: That and "Square Meals In the Basement"! My consultant, the erudite Mr. Zhongli, described it as a meticulous masterpiece! Ooh — quote that on the cover! It'll practically sell itself!

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: ...Director, we're a small business. If we invest money in printing and nobody buys it, it's my bottom line that's affected.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Don't you worry! I guarantee you, when this anthology comes out, it will take the world by storm! Gods and ghosts alike will weep!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, I heard a ghost crying on the way here. If you don't believe me, I can bring it over?

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: ...There'll be no need for that.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...It's you.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I thought about what you said... and tried to write a poem.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: After putting my feelings onto paper, my heart feels much calmer...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Can they... really hear it...?

dialogues.speaker: (Listen...)
dialogues.text: (A happy melody...)

dialogues.speaker: Huanxi
dialogues.text: It's nice to have a chance to write poetry with our friends from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Huanxi
dialogues.text: But simply standing at the venue gets boring, so I brought some fruits and vegetables from my hometown to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Huanxi
dialogues.text: Oh, but if you're looking to talk about poetry, I'm all ears.

dialogues.speaker: Levin
dialogues.text: I heard that they specially sent someone over from The Cat's Tail as the mixologist for this event.

dialogues.speaker: Levin
dialogues.text: I've never really visited, since it's always so crowded in there, but I'm dying to try just how good their drinks are.

dialogues.speaker: Jochen
dialogues.text: Please take a seat wherever you like. Enjoy the scenery, write a poem or two, and top it off with the finest drinks.

dialogues.speaker: Jochen
dialogues.text: ...Huh, people in Liyue and Mondstadt sure have similar ways to pass the time.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: I think the answer to the riddle on the left is "Glaze Lily."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: But according to the riddle, these flowers were once everywhere... Were there really that many Glaze Lilies?

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: What about Mint? The poem did say something about the plant being fragrant.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: I still think Glaze Lilies fit the description better.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Has anyone solved the riddle on the right? I'm running out of ideas. Wait, could it be something I've never seen before?

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: I know what it is, but I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to tell...

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: C'mon, it's just the answer to a riddle!

dialogues.speaker: Revealed Riddle Answer
dialogues.text: Glaze Lilies, Golden Raven Insignia.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: If I remember correctly, Liyue's couplets can be quite difficult to write...

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's harder if you follow the rules and try to match every word.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Apart from having exactly the same number of syllables, you have to take note of certain tonal patterns and make the words rhyme...

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Anyway, it's a rare opportunity to have guests visiting from Mondstadt, so let's all just enjoy ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Poem
dialogues.text: "I want to be a mushroom. Not blue like a lake, nor reflecting the moon."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Poem
dialogues.text: "I just want to be an ordinary mushroom, a mushroom no one bothers to pick."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Poem
dialogues.text: "I want to hide within the foot of the tree, unless a forest boar happens to discover me. Then it'll put me atop its head, as if I'm a crown of flowers made."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Poem
dialogues.text: "You see, I didn't want this fungal metamorphosis, because it's just an excuse for loneliness."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Poem
dialogues.text: "Color the lyre-strings like a rainbow. Pitter-patter, pitter-patter."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Poem
dialogues.text: "Even the leaves taste sweet whenever rain falls."

dialogues.speaker: Batlo
dialogues.text: This is the spot where the painting needs to be restored...

dialogues.speaker: Batlo
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! I'm so happy to see you again. Thanks again for helping me track down the original scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Batlo
dialogues.text: With your help, surely I can restore these paintings more efficiently.

dialogues.speaker: Buies
dialogues.text: So? Do you want to find some inspiration?

response.speaker: Buies
response.text: Sure thing. This way. Prepare to be inspired!

response.speaker: Buies
response.text: Very well. Come find me when you want to try.

dialogues.speaker: Ting Zhi
dialogues.text: Do you want to try playing Hundred-Pace Hurling Rites?

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: Here are your Darts, and the pots are over there.

response.speaker: Ting Zhi
response.text: No problem. I have everything set up already. Just drop by when you want to try.
